Create an ORIGINAL game building sprite for the D'thorga field bin: a round steel grain bin that stands at the edge of a paddock and holds a harvest until it is carted away, in a hard-scrabble frontier colony. No grain, no ground, no people, no animals, no vehicles, no dust, mud or damage, no text, letters, numbers, logos, dials, screens or lamps. No floor, field, shadow outside the object, perspective, tilt or visible side faces. Top surfaces only.
